name: Mykonos
short: Mykonos has long been one of Greece’s most iconic wedding destinations, loved for its Cycladic beauty, golden beaches and unmistakably cosmopolitan atmosphere. Yet even on an island famous for its vibrant lifestyle, privacy is never out of reach. With the right wedding planning, your ceremony can unfold far from the crowds without sacrificing the views, romance or style that brought you to Mykonos in the first place. Think of exchanging vows aboard a private yacht cruising along the island’s coastline or near the secluded islet of Tragonissi. From venue selection and wedding design to accommodation, guest transfers, yacht charters and every detail of the day itself, our team creates a wedding in Mykonos shaped entirely around you.
